title: Urchin Skipper Simulator
author: LucidFir
selftext:
If anyone feels like having a go and has any feedback at all I would be interested. 

I know I've got to work on sound, UI, the information you get displayed, a lot of defaults, images, it's a lot of placeholder. 

I love the kelp Astra made. I'm pretty happy with the islands and the water, the waves, rocks, reefs, sand bars, the environment stuff. I like the boat handling, at the very least the Harbour Workhorse feels just like a boat I run irl (you should reverse after dropping divers so you can bow in to them, or you'll be stuck doing a giant circle around them).

The DFO should only stop you once every 10 days, but I'm sure that's not good ux to have it happen so early like that. I probably need to delay it a few days and then reduce the in game time it takes. 

...

This should play well on Steam Deck or large tablets screen size. Presumably anything larger will be extra nice. 

It does not work well with the Steam Deck controls. I have no idea why, obviously. Controls seem to be a blind spot with Astra. It cannot get X and Y right, to the point I'm probably going to have to custom write the info that tells you what X and Y do so I can do it intentionally "wrong". It works best with gamepad, then touch screen, and then keyboard.

I also need to do an update to make this playable on my S22 phone. None of the menus scroll.
